Needs changes before merge.

The catalog uses the same rows as `tools/list`. The CLI smoke checks pass. The held Claude skill edit remains on #1947, and this PR correctly uses `Refs #1947`.

Results from the local trial merge with upstream/main `16d23d979d216c92e23701eeb7f9fbabb12ed9f4`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: FAIL. 127 steps, one failed, 24.7 minutes. The selected app test targets built successfully.
- Test totals: 975 passed, one failed, nine ignored. The ignored tests were not run.
- `mcp_doc_drift`: four passed, one failed.
- CLI checks: `mcp reference`, `mcp prompt`, and `mcp --help` pass. Both generated outputs list 116 tools.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS (14m 18s).

Exact failure:

```text
thread 'the_committed_reference_matches_the_live_tool_table' panicked at crates/app/tests/mcp_doc_drift.rs:68:5:
docs/agents/mcp-tools.md is out of date with the MCP tool table. Write it again with:
cargo run -p camcraft-app --bin camcraft-cli -- mcp reference > docs/agents/mcp-tools.md
```

Requested before merge:

1. `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md:10`: Generate the reference again after a merge of current main. The `import_model` description on main now includes edges outside their surfaces and export tolerance. The committed row lacks that text. This makes the new drift test fail on the trial merge. Run the quick gate again on the updated branch.
2. `crates/app/tests/mcp_doc_drift.rs:1`: Add a Gate map for the MCP tool table, catalog, and prompt context. This file has no Gate map. `xtask/src/quick.rs::map_modules` selects source coverage from those maps. A later tool-only edit will omit this suite. The present gate selects it only because the test file itself changed. Confirm that a tool-only diff selects the drift suite.
3. `crates/app/src/cli.rs:318` (PR validation): Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. List the lanes and results in the PR body. The current planner selects all app heavy lanes: 199 planned steps, including the release build. The body lists no heavy results. Current upstream AGENTS.md requires this evidence before readiness. I ran the plan only; the heavy tests were not run. A plan is not a pass.

Extra suites run:

No extra fixture or importer suites were required. This PR changes no fixture, golden, or importer code.

Mutations:

Not run. This PR changes no posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No goldens moved.

This PR has the label `needs-rework`. The open items are in the latest review comment on this PR. Push a fix, or say that you keep this PR. The maintainer asked for this reminder.

Addressed:

1. Merged current main and generated the MCP reference again. Only the `import_model` row changed.
   Pin: `the_committed_reference_matches_the_live_tool_table`. The stale reference failed; the restored reference passed.
2. Added Gate maps for the tool table, catalog, provider and fallback.
   Pin: `the_drift_suite_maps_the_tool_table_catalog_and_prompt_context`. The removed map failed; the restored map passed.
   A temporary tool-only diff selected `mcp_doc_drift` in the real quick plan. All six drift pins pass.
3. Ran the heavy gate on the final head. The PR body lists the lanes and results.
   The heavy gate is RED: 200 steps, one unexpected failure. Forty tests passed. Six tests had expected failures.
   `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` failed at line 144.

I reviewed the whole PR diff against current upstream AGENTS.md. I checked all three findings from the earlier review.

- The generated reference matches the live tool table. All six drift tests pass.
- The drift suite has Gate maps for the tool table, catalog, provider and fallback. The real quick plan selects the suite.
- The body now lists the heavy lanes and their results. The earlier bore failure is resolved on current main. The local trial merge passes that test and the full reached heavy plan.
- The held Claude skill edit stays on #1947. `Refs #1947` correctly leaves that work open.
